title: Cardiopulmonary Register for Intensive Care Medicine Aachen
summary:
A registry is to be established as part of the planned clinical observational study. This registry will include all patients who are being treated in the cardiology or pulmonology intensive care unit (IM 18/IM 19) at RWTH Aachen University Hospital due to severe heart failure (cardiogenic shock) or severe lung failure (ARDS).
The aim of the registry is to record certain measurements and examination findings that may provide clues as to how the course of the disease and the prognosis of these seriously ill patients will develop. These so-called predictive markers, either individually or in combination with other parameters, should help to better understand and assess the individual course of the disease.
conditions: Cardiogenic shock and acute respiratory distress syndrome (lung failure, ARDS)

interventions.name: Observational study including all patients hospitalised in the cardiology/pulmonology intensive care unit (IM 18/IM19) of the University Hospital RWTH Aachen due to cardiogenic shock or ARDS.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients admitted to the intensive care unit with the primary clinical picture of cardiogenic shock or ARDS
-    Defining criteria for cardiogenic shock:
o    RR <100 mmHg systolic or catecholamine therapy
o    Initial lactate >2 mmol/l or other signs of end-organ hypoperfusion (AKI, hepatopathy)
-    Definitional criteria for ARDS:
o    Presence of bilateral, non-cardiac infiltrates
o	Respiratory failure requiring intubation with Horowitz index ≤300 mmHg at PEEP ≥5 cmH20 or respiratory failure not requiring intubation with Horowitz index ≤300 mmHg and need for non-invasive ventilation with high-flow oxygen therapy (≥ 30 L/min) or NIV-CPAP (PEEP ≥ 5 cmH20)
Exclusion criteria:
Pregnancy and breastfeeding
- Cardiogenic shock/ARDS as a progressive clinical picture in patients already being treated in intensive care for a primarily different clinical picture
- Cardiogenic shock/ARDS as a complication of surgery
- Following heart and/or lung transplantation
- Metastatic cancer
